QuestInfo.name: The First Form
QuestInfo.0: Offer the younger pupils advice on how to use forms.
QuestInfo.1:
The younger pupils took the opportunity to ask you for an impromptu demonstration. 
After some consideration, you decide to show them the basic forms.

#b*Open the Skill window by pressing the K key.
#b* You obtain SP each time you level up and you can use it to increase a skill's level.
#b* Skills can be registered to the keys on the bottom right for convenience.
QuestInfo.2:
Upon hearing the splintering of training dummies, Xiao Xiao came running and demanded a sparring match. 
She never was one to change her mind, so you'd better prepare yourself.

#b* You can open the character's Stat Window by pressing the S key or the C key.
#b* You obtain AP each time you level up and you can invest AP into the stats of your choice.

default.0: Please gives us a demonstration! We want to see!
